act-write-limited-practice.valid.json.note: every act is a recommendation while Tier 2 is not in force (AA-01, AW-16)

act-write-full-practice.valid.json.note: every act is a recommendation while Tier 2 is not in force (AA-01, AW-16)

act-write-unknown-act-class.valid.json.note: the class is kept as declared (AN-06; ruling 188)

act-write-missing-legal-review-ref.valid.note: a missing field of the claim is the step-8 code it would answer (AD-63)

act-write-limited-missing-allowlist-entr.note: a missing field of the claim is the step-9 code it would answer (AD-63)

act-write-no-evidence.valid.json.note: recorded, shown as resting on no evidence reference and flagged for review (AD-63)

act-write-without-act-type.valid.json.note: the clinician who adopts it completes the missing parts (ruling 188; AD-63)

act-write-without-authority.valid.json.note: no authority claimed names no grant version, the first grant check it can fail while a grant is current (AD-63)

act-write-without-declared-flags.valid.j.note: absent declared_reserved and emergency_indicated mean true, shown as defaulted; listed urgently (AD-63, AA-06)

act-write-without-consent-ref.valid.json.note: no consent reference is not refused: the receipt carries consent_ref_missing whatever the first failing check, and the medical director is flagged (AD-62, PROPOSED)

act-write-without-content-schema.valid.j.note: the content is kept as given with no declared schema (AD-63)

act-write-declared-clinical-note.valid.j.note: declared a note, but its content is not the foundation's note content, so it is a recommendation with no_decision_authority; note content would be kept_as_information (the foundation's AN-06 and CD-65; ruling 187; AD-68)

act-write-note-content.valid.json.note: declared a note, and its content validates as the foundation's note content: information that only records who wrote it, kept as the foundation's information record, marked not signed off, after the consent and grant checks, and selected for clinician review (ruling 187; the foundation's AN-06 and AN-14; AD-68, AD-69)

act-write-document-content.valid.json.note: declared a document, and its content validates as the foundation's document shape: kept as the foundation's information record after the consent and grant checks, and selected for clinician review (the foundation's AN-06 and CD-65; AD-68, AD-69)

act-write-document-without-consent.valid.note: an AI's document with no consent reference is quarantined in the chart, listed for clinician review and flagged to the medical director; never refused, never kept unchecked as information (AW-06, AC-11; AD-62, AD-69, PROPOSED)

act-write-note-emergency.valid.json.note: kept as information after the consent and grant checks, selected for clinician review, and listed urgently for the responsible clinician and the medical director with its review due within 1 hour (AW-06, AW-16; AD-69, PROPOSED)

consult-write-missing-on-behalf-of.valid.note: no AI named: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-names-no-ai.v.note: a relay names only the source system, so no AI: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-ai-without-model-version.v.note: the AI is named without its model version: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-ai-without-model.valid.jso.note: the AI is named without its model: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-openwallet-id-bad-shape.va.note: a value outside openWallet's identifier shape is no openWallet ID: held outside the chart, never refused, and the value is never shown or logged as given (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-missing-source.valid.json.note: no source: openChart supplies ai_consult with the consult_id as its reference, marked as defaulted (AD-63)

act-write-missing-source.valid.json.note: no source: openChart supplies ai_consult with consult_ref's consult_id as its reference, marked as defaulted (AD-63)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-starts-with-s.note: the source system is named before the AI, so on_behalf_of cannot be read as this path reads it: held outside the chart, never refused, and never reordered, because ruling 80, clause 7 makes the order meaningful (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-names-human.v.note: the 1.0 contract reads no human in on_behalf_of: held outside the chart, never refused; the human party is kept as it arrived and stays out of every alert (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-three-parties.note: three parties where this path reads at most the AI and the source system: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-empty.valid.j.note: an empty on_behalf_of names no AI: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-two-ais.valid.note: two AIs: openChart never guesses which produced the content, so it is held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 80, clause 7; ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-names-healthl.note: a relay's second party names a system that is never a write-path system, so it is not the write's source system: held outside the chart, never refused (AD-30; ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-relay-omits-source-system..note: a relay names the AI but not the source system it passed through: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 80, clause 7; ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-ai-model-outside-form.vali.note: the model is present but outside its pattern (a space): held outside the chart, never refused, never releasable, and the value is never shown, logged or returned as given (ruling 194; AW-07; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-ai-model-version-outside-f.note: the model version is present but outside its pattern (a slash): held outside the chart, never refused, never releasable, and the value is never shown, logged or returned as given (ruling 194; AW-07; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-ai-party-unknown-property..note: the AI party carries a property this path does not read: held outside the chart, never refused; the property is kept as it arrived and stays out of every alert (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-openwallet-id-300-characte.note: 300 characters, within the 1024-character bound but beyond openWallet's 200, so no openWallet ID: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-ai-party-kind-uppercase.va.note: kind AI is not kind ai, and openChart never guesses: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

act-write-ai-model-outside-form.valid.js.note: an act whose AI's model is outside its pattern: held outside the chart, never refused, and no recommendation is recorded while it is held (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

consult-write-corrected-resend.valid.jso.note: resends the consult_id, version and exchange of consult-write-ai-model-outside-form with the AI's model in its form: not a duplicate of that held write, because its on_behalf_of differs; checked as a new write, accepted, and linked to the held write, which is flagged as corrected so that a clinician can dismiss it as duplicate_of_existing_record, naming this record (AW-05, AC-11; AD-71, PROPOSED)

consult-write-missing-ended-at.valid.jso.note: no ended_at: openChart takes received_at as when the consult ended, marks it as defaulted, and checks the grant at receipt; never refused (AW-15; AD-70, PROPOSED)

consult-write-missing-started-at.valid.j.note: no started_at: the record shows the start as not stated; never refused (AW-15; AD-70, PROPOSED)

consult-write-ended-at-without-zone.vali.note: ended_at is not a timestamp of this contract (no zone): openChart takes received_at, marks it as defaulted, keeps the value given with its record of the write, and checks the grant at receipt (AW-15; AD-70, PROPOSED)

act-write-note-without-occurred-at.valid.note: an AI's note with no occurred_at: kept as information with received_at as when it arose, marked as defaulted, after the consent and grant checks at receipt, and selected for clinician review (AW-06, AW-15; AD-69, AD-70, PROPOSED)

act-write-note-occurred-after-receipt.va.note: dated a day after its receipt, beyond the 5-minute clock skew: kept as information with received_at as when it arose, marked as defaulted, the declared value kept with the record of the write, and selected for clinician review (AW-15; AD-69, AD-70, PROPOSED)

act-write-discontinue-with-target.valid..note: proposed action discontinue on the target as given; under Tier 2, targets_clinician_record where the target is a clinician's record (AD-68)

act-write-sign-supersedes-own-act.valid..note: a new recommendation that corrects the source's earlier one (AN-09; AW-16)

consult-write-advice-only.valid.json.note: an advice-only consult under its current grant (AC-01)

consult-write-scenario-context.valid.jso.note: declared test data is refused with non_operational_context (AW-04)

consult-write-ai-without-openwallet-id.v.note: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60)

consult-write-missing-models.valid.json.note: the record shows the AI's model and version from on_behalf_of (AD-63)

consult-write-missing-consent-ref.valid..note: quarantined in the chart and flagged to the medical director (AD-62, PROPOSED)

consult-write-without-authority.valid.js.note: no authority claimed names no grant version: quarantined in the chart (AD-63)

consult-write-without-emergency-indicato.note: absent emergency_indicated means true: listed urgently and always reviewed, shown as defaulted (AD-63)

consult-write-declarations-absent.valid..note: nothing but the envelope, identity, patient, provenance and content: quarantined in the chart for want of consent, emergency defaulted to true (AD-62, AD-63)

consult-write-pdf-attachment.valid.json.note: a display-only attachment, never parsed or imported (AC-04)

consult-write-models-outside-form.valid..note: models set aside, as absent: the record shows the AI's model and model version from on_behalf_of only; the value given is kept with openChart's record of the write and never shown, logged or returned as given (AW-07; AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-evidence-kind-outside-list.note: evidence_refs set aside, as missing evidence: recorded, shown as resting on no consult-level evidence reference, and selected for review whatever the sample by the no-evidence trigger, which a list set aside always meets (AC-03, AC-07; AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-authority-grant-version-st.note: authority.grant_version set aside, answered by the check it would have answered, as a missing grant version is: quarantined in the chart with grant_mismatch (AG-06; AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-authority-mode-unknown.val.note: authority.mode set aside, answered by the check it would have answered: quarantined in the chart with mode_mismatch (AG-06; AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-review-flags-outside-form..note: review_flags set aside, failing closed as if red_flag were declared: selected for review whatever the sample and listed urgently, with the 1-hour window wherever a fixed window applies (AC-07, AC-11; AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-turn-at-without-zone.valid.note: a turn's time cannot be read: the turn is kept as given, inside the content digest, and its time shown as not stated; not selected for that alone (AC-02; AD-70, AD-75, PROPOSED)

consult-write-ended-before-started.valid.note: an ended_at before its started_at is a time that cannot be read: openChart takes received_at as the end, marked as defaulted, shows the start as not stated, keeps both values given with its record of the write, and checks the grant at receipt (AW-15; AD-70, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-escalation-unknown-route.v.note: escalation set aside, as absent: the routing is shown as not stated, and the consult is selected for review whatever the sample, failing closed (AC-03, AC-07; AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-emergency-indicated-string.note: emergency_indicated set aside, counted as true and shown as defaulted: listed urgently and always reviewed (AC-10; AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-consent-ref-outside-form.v.note: a consent reference outside its form is a missing one: quarantined in the chart with consent_ref_missing and flagged to the medical director, as ruling 199 keeps such a consult (AC-11; AD-62, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-summary-wrong-type.valid.j.note: summary set aside, as absent: no AI summary is shown; the value given is kept with openChart's record of the write and never shown (AC-01; AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-conversation-ref-wrong-typ.note: conversation_ref set aside, as absent: no inbox item is associated with the consult by it (AC-01; AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-structured-attachment.vali.note: an attachment of a media type that is not only displayed sits inside a content object that can be read: the consult is kept, the attachment kept by reference and digest only and never displayed, and the consult always selected for review for content outside its shape (AC-04, AC-07; AD-75, PROPOSED)

consult-write-unknown-property.valid.jso.note: a member the schema does not define is set aside unread, and an integration exception carrying identifiers only is raised to the administrative role (AW-01; AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-clinician-turn.valid.json.note: a turn whose author type a consult does not admit: the consult is kept, the turn kept as given with its author recorded and shown as unknown, never as a clinician, and the consult always selected for review for content outside its shape; no new quarantine cause (AC-02, AC-07; AD-75, PROPOSED)

consult-write-no-ai-turn.valid.json.note: a consult with no AI turn: kept, its turns shown as given and patient-reported, and always selected for review for content outside its shape (AC-02, AC-07; AD-75, PROPOSED)

consult-write-patient-turn-knowledge-bas.note: a knowledge basis on a patient turn: the consult is kept, the basis kept as given and never shown, and the consult always selected for review for content outside its shape (AC-03, AC-07; AD-75, PROPOSED)

consult-write-source-kind-not-ai-consult.note: source set aside, as absent: openChart supplies ai_consult with consult_id as its reference, marked as defaulted (AW-15; AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-bad-timestamp.valid.json.note: sent_at set aside: openChart uses received_at wherever a sending time is needed, marked as defaulted (AW-15; AD-70, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-timestamp-ten-fraction-dig.note: ten fractional-second digits are outside the foundation's pattern, so sent_at is set aside and received_at used, marked as defaulted (AW-15; AD-70, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-impossible-day.valid.json.note: a sent_at naming 30 February is a time that cannot be read: received_at is used, marked as defaulted; no time a write gives is refused (AW-15; AD-70, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-source-healthlinc.valid.js.note: a source system that is never a write-path system is not refused for that: its patient is matched in the namespace it names (AW-03), and the AI check holds the write with ai_not_identified, the first cause it reaches, because a relay's on_behalf_of cannot name such a system as the source system; it is never released, and no registration covers it either. A source patient reference in another namespace would match no link and be refused with patient_link_unknown. The namespace bar refuses only the writer (AD-30; ruling 194; AD-60, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-source-openpractice-agent..note: held with ai_not_identified and never released, as consult-write-source-healthlinc is; the namespace bar refuses only the writer (AD-30; ruling 194; AD-60, AD-74, PROPOSED)

consult-write-on-behalf-of-party-not-obj.note: a party of on_behalf_of that is not an object cannot be read as this path reads parties: held outside the chart, never refused (ruling 194; AD-60, PROPOSED)

act-write-knowledge-basis-unknown.valid..note: knowledge_basis set aside, as absent: shown as not stated (AA-03; AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-declared-reserved-string.valid.note: declared_reserved set aside, counted as true and shown as defaulted, failing closed (AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-act-type-outside-form.valid.js.note: act_type set aside, as missing: the clinician who adopts it completes the missing parts (ruling 188; AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-content-schema-wrong-type.vali.note: content_schema set aside, as absent: the content is kept as given with no declared schema (AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-consult-ref-version-zero.valid.note: consult_ref set aside, as absent: the act names no consult, so no consult review covers it (AW-16; AD-69, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-unknown-action.valid.json.note: an action outside the foundation's codes is set aside: the proposed act takes the default action, sign, because the write names no target, and the value given is kept with openChart's record of the write (AD-58, AD-68, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-discontinue-without-target.val.note: an action on an existing record that names none cannot be applied: set aside, and the proposed act takes the default action, sign (AD-58, AD-68, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-sign-with-target.valid.json.note: sign names no existing record, so with a target the action is set aside and the proposed act takes the default for a write that names a target, new_version (AN-09; AD-58, AD-68, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-source-clinician-observation.v.note: an AI's act is never a clinician's observation: source set aside, as absent, and openChart supplies ai_consult with consult_ref's consult_id as its reference, marked as defaulted (AW-15; AD-63, AD-74, PROPOSED)

act-write-note-occurred-at-impossible-da.note: an occurred_at naming 30 February cannot be read: received_at is taken, marked occurred_at_defaulted; the value given is kept only with openChart's record of the write, never as the foundation's occurred_at_as_declared, which takes only a timestamp (AW-15; AD-69, AD-70, AD-74, PROPOSED)
